'''Matt Rheude''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Cincinnati tournament]] on 30 June 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS podracing]], according to John Veasey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2560">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01d2560/ cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01], DeckTech (John "jpvz" Veasey, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01d2560/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
